lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਕਉ ਤਰਸਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis naamai kau tarasahi bahu devaa ||
lines.translation: So many gods yearn for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal bhagat jaa kee karade sevaa ||
lines.translation: All the devotees serve Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anaathaa naath deen dukh bha(n)jan so gur poore te paainaa ||3||
lines.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor. His Name is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor duaaraa koi na soojhai ||
lines.translation: I cannot conceive of any other door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tribhavan dhaavai taa kichhoo na boojhai ||
lines.translation: One who wanders through the three worlds, understands nothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਨਾਮ ਜਿਸੁ ਇਹੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur saahu bha(n)daar naam jis ihu ratan tisai te paainaa ||4||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the banker, with the treasure of the Naam. This jewel is obtained from Him. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee dhoor kare puneetaa ||
lines.translation: The dust of His feet purifies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar dev na paavahi meetaa ||
lines.translation: Even the angelic beings and gods cannot obtain it, O friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sat purakh satigur paramesar jis bhetat paar paraainaa ||5||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the True Primal Being, the Transcendent Lord God; meeting with Him, one is carried across to the other side. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarajaat loRahi man piaare ||
lines.translation: O my beloved mind, if you wish for the 'tree of life';

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਸੋਹੀ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaamadhen sohee darabaare ||
lines.translation: if you wish for Kaamadhayna, the wish-fulfilling cow to adorn your court;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਰਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: tripat sa(n)tokh sevaa gur poore naam kamaai rasaainaa ||6||
lines.translation: if you wish to be satisfied and contented, then serve the Perfect Guru, and practice the Naam, the source of nectar. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad marahi pa(n)ch dhaatoo ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the five thieves of desire are conquered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਤੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai paarabraham hovahi niramalaa too ||
lines.translation: In the Fear of the Supreme Lord God, you shall become immaculate and pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਣਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: paaras jab bhetai gur pooraa taa paaras paras dikhaainaa ||7||
lines.translation: When one meets the Perfect Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, His touch reveals the Lord, the Philosopher's Stone. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaee baiku(n)th naahee lavai laage ||
lines.translation: Myriads of heavens do not equal the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਭੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਿਆਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat bapuRee bhee giaanee tiaage ||
lines.translation: The spiritually wise forsake mere liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: eka(n)kaar satigur te paaeeai hau bal bal gur darasaainaa ||8||
lines.translation: The One Universal Creator Lord is found through the True Guru. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee sev na jaanai koee ||
lines.translation: No one knows how to serve the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur paarabraham agochar soee ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the unfathomable, Supreme Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਇਣਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: jis no laai lae so sevak jis vadabhaag mathaainaa ||9||
lines.translation: He alone is the Guru's servant, whom the Guru Himself links to His service, and upon whose forehead such blessed destiny is inscribed. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee mahimaa bed na jaanahi ||
lines.translation: Even the Vedas do not know the Guru's Glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਛ ਮਾਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tuchh maat sun sun vakhaanahi ||
lines.translation: They narrate only a tiny bit of what is heard.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham apara(n)par satigur jis simarat man seetalaainaa ||10||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Incomparable One; meditating in remembrance on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee soi sunee man jeevai ||
lines.translation: Hearing of Him, the mind comes to life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਠੰਢਾ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ridai vasai taa tha(n)dhaa theevai ||
lines.translation: When He dwells within the heart, one becomes peaceful and cool.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ ਤਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: gurumukhahu alaae taa sobhaa paae tis jam kai pa(n)th na paainaa ||11||
lines.translation: Chanting the Guru's Name with the mouth, one obtains glory, and does not have to walk on the Path of Death. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan kee saranaaee paRiaa ||
lines.translation: I have entered the Sanctuary of the Saints,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਧਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu praan dhan aagai dhariaa ||
lines.translation: and placed before them my soul, my breath of life and wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਾਈ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਿਰਮਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa surat na jaanaa kaaee tum karahu daiaa kiramaainaa ||12||
lines.translation: I know nothing about service and awareness; please take pity upon this worm. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਰਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: niragun kau sa(n)g lehu ralaae ||
lines.translation: I am unworthy; please merge me into Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਟਹਲੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi tahalai laae ||
lines.translation: Please bless me with Your Grace, and link me to Your service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਉ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: pakhaa pherau peesau sa(n)t aagai charan dhoi sukh paainaa ||13||
lines.translation: I wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; washing their feet, I find peace. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahut duaare bhram bhram aaiaa ||
lines.translation: After wandering around at so many doors, I have come to Yours, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree kripaa te tum saranaaiaa ||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, I have entered Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa sa(n)tah sa(n)g raakhahu ehu naam daan devaainaa ||14||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, keep me in the Company of the Saints; please bless me with this Gift of Your Name. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kripaal gusaaee mere ||
lines.translation: My World-Lord has become merciful,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan paaiaa satigur poore ||
lines.translation: and I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Perfect True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੫॥੨॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj sadaa aana(n)daa naanak daas dasaainaa ||15||2||7||
lines.translation: I have found eternal peace, poise and bliss; Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||15||2||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰੈ ਧਰਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਆਕਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarai dharatee ar aakaasaa ||
lines.translation: The earth and the Akaashic ethers meditate in remembrance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarahi cha(n)d sooraj gunataasaa ||
lines.translation: The moon and the sun meditate in remembrance on You, O treasure of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)tar simarahi simarai sagal upaarajanaa ||1||
lines.translation: Air, water and fire meditate in remembrance. All creation meditates in remembrance. ||1||
